name: elevation_mean
operator: Priority-Flood-filled mean elevation of the aligned 200 m cell
resampling: valid-area average from GLO-30 to the aligned 200 m grid
coverage_rule: final node DEM valid fraction is at least 0.8

name: slope_mean
operator: 3x3 Horn slope on the conditioned 200 m DSM

name: relative_elevation_1km
operator: center elevation minus valid-cell mean in the centered 5x5 window
coverage_rule: use all valid cells in the centered 5x5 window

name: local_relief_1km
operator: valid-cell maximum minus minimum in the centered 5x5 window
coverage_rule: at least 13 valid cells in the centered 5x5 window

name: log_flow_accumulation
operator: ln(1 + N_upstream * 0.04), with the focal cell included

name: twi
operator: ln((specific catchment area + 1 m) / tan(max(slope, 0.5 degree)))
coverage_rule: valid conditioned D8 cell and finite Horn slope

name: event_rainfall_total
operator: sum of half-hour precipitation rates multiplied by 0.5 h
resampling: nearest native 0.1 degree pixel center to each 200 m grid center
temporal_rule: interval midpoint in the closed event window
coverage_rule: every required half-hour slice is finite; otherwise NaN

name: max_6h_rainfall
operator: maximum complete sum over 12 consecutive half-hour amounts
resampling: nearest native 0.1 degree pixel center to each 200 m grid center
temporal_rule: complete 6 h windows wholly inside the closed event window
coverage_rule: all 12 slices in a candidate window are finite; otherwise skip that window

name: antecedent_72h_rainfall
resampling: nearest native 0.1 degree pixel center to each 200 m grid center
temporal_rule: half-open interval from event start minus 72 h to event start
coverage_rule: all 144 slices are finite; otherwise NaN

name: built_up_fraction
operator: class-50 valid area divided by valid target-cell area
resampling: nearest categorical reprojection followed by aligned 20x20 aggregation
coverage_rule: valid coverage is at least 0.5 of the target cell

name: water_fraction
operator: class-80 valid area divided by valid target-cell area
resampling: nearest categorical reprojection followed by aligned 20x20 aggregation
coverage_rule: valid coverage is at least 0.5 of the target cell

name: vegetation_fraction
operator: classes 10/20/30/90/95/100 valid area divided by valid target-cell area
resampling: nearest categorical reprojection followed by aligned 20x20 aggregation
coverage_rule: valid coverage is at least 0.5 of the target cell

name: cropland_fraction
operator: class-40 valid area divided by valid target-cell area
resampling: nearest categorical reprojection followed by aligned 20x20 aggregation
coverage_rule: valid coverage is at least 0.5 of the target cell

name: road_length_density
operator: eligible road length clipped to the cell and divided by 0.04 km2
resampling: projected vector intersection with each 200 m cell
coverage_rule: zero is valid when no eligible road intersects the cell

name: waterway_length_density
operator: eligible waterway length clipped to the cell and divided by 0.04 km2
resampling: projected vector intersection with each 200 m cell
coverage_rule: zero is valid when no eligible waterway intersects the cell

name: distance_to_nearest_waterway
operator: Euclidean distance from cell center to nearest eligible waterway
resampling: projected vector distance capped at 10000 m
coverage_rule: use 10000 m when the context contains no eligible waterway

name: distance_to_WorldCover_waterbody
operator: Euclidean distance from cell center to nearest class-80 pixel boundary
resampling: distance on the projected 10 m categorical grid, capped at 10000 m
coverage_rule: search the administrative AOI plus 10 km context

name: log1p_population_density
operator: log1p(population count / valid target area in km2)
resampling: sum-preserving population-count reprojection to the aligned 200 m grid
coverage_rule: valid coverage is at least 0.5 of the target cell
